ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"),made as ofSeptember23,2014,by and betweenCHEHEBARASSOCIATES LLC, having an address at c/o Maverick Management Corp., 1000 Pennsylvania Avenue, Brooklyn, NewYork 11207 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner") and LEXIN NY 83 LLC, having an address at c/o Lexin Capital, LLC, 654 Madison Avenue,New York, New York 10065 (hereinafter referred to as"Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of NewYork, County of New York, known as and by the street address 85 Nassau Street and the tax lot Block 79, Lot 2 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title or contract purchaser of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, County of New York, known as and by the street addresses 83 Nassau Street and the tax lot Block 79, Lots 3 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Building"; WHEREAS, Developer intends, to construct a new building or modify or alter the existing building upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new building or modification of the existing building,with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the "New Building"; and said land and New Building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as"Developer'sProperty"; Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a"Parcel"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the "Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent "zoning lot", with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Land and

Owner's Land into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Buildingwithsuchlimitation; WHEREAS,there existFloorAreaDevelopmentRights (hereinafter defined)which are appurtenant to Owner's Landwhich arein excess of theFloorAreaDevelopment Rights utilized by Owner's Building (the“Available Development Rights,'as hereafter defined) and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. As used in this Agreement, the term "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, (ii) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution including the right to use Owner's Property for purposes of calculating inclusionary rights available to Developer's Property under section 23-90 of the Zoning Resolution, and (i) the inclusion of any further use, bulk, density and other development rightspermitted under theZoningResolutionwhich maybe authorized tobe developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York (the "City"); WHEREAS, in order to construct the NewBuilding with the excess bulk on Developer's Land, Developer acquired the Available Development Rights from Owner's Land pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot Merger Purchase and Sale Agreement ("Sales Agreement")between Developer and Owner dated as of September 9, 2014 (the "Effective Date"). As used in this Agreement,"AvailableDevelopmentRights"shall mean all oftheFloorAreaDevelopment Rights appurtenant on the date hereof to the zoning lot in which the Owner's Property is located in excess of the floor area utilized by Owner's Building, and any other structures located on Owner's Property on the date hereof. Owner has agreed to permit Developer to utilize Owner's Available Development Rights, on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth, it being understood and agreed, however, that Owner is retaining for its own benefit (i) all floor area utilized by Owner's Building, and any other structures located on Owner's Property on the date hereof, and (i) all Floor Area Development Rights pertaining to Owner's Property resulting from an upward revision on or after the date hereof by NewYork City of the allowablefloor area ratio and/or the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density or other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution,including any bonus floor area availablepursuant toSection23-90 of the ZoningResolution,that become available to Owner's Property after the date hereof (suchFloorArea Development Rightsbeingretained by Owner are referred toherein as the"Retained Development Rights"); WHEREAS, the Developer's Land and/or the Single Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) may be the receiving site of a transfer of certain Additional Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and Developer may acquire such Additional Development Rights for utilization on Developer's Land or the Single Zoning Lot (other than the Owner's Property), “Additional Development Rights" shall mean any additional Floor Area Development Rights that may become available to the Developer's Property or the Single Zoning Lot (either by expansion of 2
